# axual_connect_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up a Kafka Connect cluster already registered on an Instance-Cluster, so its id can be used as an `axual_application_deployment`'s `target_id`. Registering, changing or removing a Kafka Connect cluster is an administrator action outside Terraform; this data source is read-only.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The Uid of the Cluster the Kafka Connect cluster belongs to.
- `instance_id` (String) The Uid of the Instance the Kafka Connect cluster belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The Kafka Connect cluster's unique identifier. Provide this or `name`.
- `name` (String) The Kafka Connect cluster's name. Provide this or `id`. Looking up by name reads every page of the cluster list, since the API has no server-side name filter for this resource.

### Read-Only

- `auth_method` (String) The Kafka authentication method every connector on this cluster must use: `MTLS` or `SASL_SCRAM`. Not the same as how Platform Manager itself authenticates to the Connect REST API. A Connector `axual_application_deployment` targeting a `SASL_SCRAM` cluster needs an `axual_application_credential` supporting `SCRAM_SHA_512`; one targeting an `MTLS` cluster needs an active `axual_application_principal`, same as legacy Axual Connect.
- `authorized_group_ids` (List of String) Uids of the groups authorized to deploy connectors to this cluster.
- `connect_url` (String) The Kafka Connect cluster's REST API base URL.
- `description` (String) A short description of the Kafka Connect cluster.
- `log_viewer_url` (String) Address of the log provisioner for this cluster, if one is configured.
- `owner_group_id` (String) Uid of the group that owns this Kafka Connect cluster registration.
- `owner_group_name` (String) Name of the group that owns this Kafka Connect cluster registration.
